summary: Agent failed to complete required verification before agreeing to place an order and made an over-confident promise about delivery; no personal-data, escalation, or conduct violations found.

findings.explanation: Agent confirmed they would place an order (an account/order action) without evidence that the account was pulled up or fully verified. The customer provided a name (turn 6) and said they were unsure of their account ID (turn 7); the system log shows only 'The purchasing department has been notified.' (turn 16) and does not show an 'Account has been pulled up' action. Policy: before any account or order action the agent must first pull up the account (full name or account ID); confirming placement of an order without that verification is a major violation.

Agent made a confident promise about the order's arrival time. The policy disallows over-confident or guaranteed delivery promises; this is a minor violation (over-confident language about a likely outcome).
